location.title: Location: Tân Hưng near Phú Mỹ Hưng | ASCON LIVING
location.description: Where ASCON LIVING is: 389A Trần Xuân Soạn, Tân Hưng (former District 7), Ho Chi Minh City, near Phú Mỹ Hưng, by the river. Estimated travel times.
location.h1: Location: riverside in Tân Hưng, near Phú Mỹ Hưng
location.lead: 389A Đường Trần Xuân Soạn, Tân Hưng, Ho Chi Minh City – in the former District 7, near Phú Mỹ Hưng, right by the river.

p: Since the 2025 administrative reform, District 7 no longer exists as a district; the house is now in Tân Hưng ward. Many people still call the area District 7 (Quận 7). Phú Mỹ Hưng is the planned urban area nearby, with shopping, restaurants and parks.

sections.note: All times are rough estimates by car and depend strongly on traffic.
ul: Tân Sơn Nhất International Airport (SGN): approx. 30–60 min (estimate)
City centre (former District 1): approx. 15–30 min (estimate)
Phú Mỹ Hưng: approx. 10–15 min (estimate)

guide-family.description: Practical tips for visiting Ho Chi Minh City with children and family: heat, traffic, getting around and planning your days.
guide-family.h1: Things to do in Ho Chi Minh City with kids
guide-family.lead: Saigon is busy, warm and very family-friendly if you plan a little.

ul: It is warm all year: plan outdoor sightseeing for the morning or late afternoon and rest at midday.
Traffic is dense and motorbikes are everywhere – hold children's hands when crossing streets.
Ride-hailing apps such as Grab are widely used and make getting around with a family simple.
Drink bottled or filtered water.
A whole house with its own kitchen makes meals and nap times easier for small children.
Saigon Zoo and Botanical Gardens (Thảo Cầm Viên), one of the oldest zoos in Vietnam
Parks and riverside walks in Phú Mỹ Hưng
Ben Thanh Market in the city centre

guide-app.title: ASCON LIVING Guide App for Ho Chi Minh City
guide-app.description: Our free guest guide app for Ho Chi Minh City: places sorted by distance from the house, travel times, routes, map and practical tips in 10 languages.
guide-app.h1: The ASCON LIVING Guide: your app for Ho Chi Minh City
guide-app.lead: Our free guest guide opens in your phone's browser – no app store needed – and shows you what is around the house and how to get there.

sections.h2: How to get around Ho Chi Minh City, made easy
p: Every place is sorted by distance from the homestay and shows estimated travel times by car, scooter and on foot. One tap on Route gives you directions from the house, or opens the place in Google Maps. The map shows all places at a glance.
imgs: ASCON Guide app: place card with distance, travel times and Route button
ASCON Guide app: map of all places around the house

ul: Food – places to eat, starting with our Top 10, with opening hours and price notes.
Cafés & desserts – coffee and sweet stops for a break.
Bars & nightlife – ideas for an evening out.
Kids & family – outings with children.
Sights & culture – the city's landmarks and cultural highlights.
Activities – things to do in and around the city.
Relaxation – places to unwind.
Shopping – where to shop.
Day trips – excursions beyond the city.
Practical & emergency – arriving at Tân Sơn Nhất Airport, getting around, show-to-driver cards, common scams, plus an SOS button.
imgs: ASCON Guide app: practical and emergency information

p: The app is available in English, German, Vietnamese, Chinese, Korean, Japanese, French, Spanish, Portuguese and Arabic. Add it to your home screen: once opened, it keeps its content on your phone, so it stays usable even with a weak connection. Handy for family travel in Vietnam, too: the Kids & family category collects outings with children.
